### Centific Announces Leadership Transition: Chuen Hong Lew to Succeed Venkat Rangapuram as Chief Executive Officer
...
Centific appoints Chuen Hong Lew, former Singapore IMDA CEO, as its new Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram effective Aug 3, 2026.
...
Centific, a leading global data and AI solutions company, today announced that Chuen Hong Lew will become Chief Executive Officer, effective August 3, 2026, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram, who has led the company through a period of significant growth and global expansion.

highlights:
# Venkat Rangapuram
...
CEO & Cofounder at Centific
...
As the CEO of Centific, I lead a global team focused on improving the relationship between people, technology, and business. Our goal is to enhance the business experience through next-gen, human-centric solutions. We approach our work with a focus on innovation, collaboration, and a deep understanding of our clients' needs, partnering with them to navigate the ever-evolving business landscape. My vision for Centific is to revolutionize the global tech services industry by shifting it towards a platform-based model that leverages data, intelligence, and experience to deliver business value. The industry has witnessed a disruptive shift to GenAI and we have leveraged our strong foundations to become a leading provider of GenAI solutions, across GenAI creators and industries. We believe the industry will experience significant growth in the segment of Frontier data as AI models become more advanced. As a Leading Provider of Frontier AI Solutions, We Endeavor to Empower Enterprises on Their AI Journey.
...
### Chief Executive Officer - [Centific](https://www.linkedin.com/company/centificglobal) (Current)
...
Jan 2023 - Present (3 years and 7 months) in United States
...
As the CEO of Centific, I lead a global team of talented individuals who grasp the vital relationship between humans, businesses, and technology. Our goal at Centific is to harness technology to enhance business outcomes and the overall human experience. Every day, we approach our work with a focus on exploration, empathy, collaboration, drive, and trust, working passionately to aid our clients in navigating the complexities of modern enterprise transformation. My personal goal is to revolutionize the global services industry by transforming it into a platform-based model that leverages data, intelligence, and experience to drive value. I am proud to say Centific is at the forefront of this. Before joining Centific, I gained invaluable experience in digital and technology consulting, where I honed my ability to translate complex business and technology challenges into strategic solutions and effectively communicate them to clients. I am proud to have been shaped by my upbringing in India, a country known for its rich and diverse cultural heritage, languages, cuisines, traditions, and lifestyles. This has profoundly impacted who I am today, and I bring this perspective to my leadership style at Centific. I am grateful for the experiences and opportunities that have shaped me as a leader and am eager about the future of Centific and the impact we will have on the world.
